extractionrun.settings.page.title: Search-Loot-Extract Settings
extractionrun.settings.maxCards.descript: Maximum number of cards you can carry into a run.
extractionrun.settings.maxRelics.descrip: Maximum number of relics you can carry into a run.
extractionrun.settings.showCardHoverTips: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over cards.
extractionrun.settings.showRelicHoverTip: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over relics.
extractionrun.settings.showPotionHoverTi: Show vanilla tooltips when hovering over potions.
extractionrun.settings.durability.enable: Cards and relics lose 1 durability per successful extraction; at 0 a copy is lost. Disabling switches the warehouse to a disposable no-durability copy (progress there is lost when re-enabling).
Max durability granted to a new starter-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.common: Max durability granted to a new common-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.uncomm: Max durability granted to a new uncommon-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.rare.d: Max durability granted to a new rare-rarity card.
extractionrun.settings.durability.ancien: Max durability granted to a new ancient-rarity card.
Max durability granted to cards of any other rarity (event/token/status/curse/quest, mod cards).
Max durability granted to a new relic (all relics share one value).
extractionrun.settings.shop.buyMultiplie: Multiplier applied to the rolled vanilla shop price when buying.
extractionrun.settings.shop.sellRatio.de: Ratio of the vanilla base price paid when selling (before the durability factor).
extractionrun.settings.reset.label: Restore Defaults
extractionrun.settings.reset.description: Restore all Search-Loot-Extract settings to their default values.
